title: Grade 3 Social Studies — How Local Government Serves a Community
subject: Social Studies
description: Practice with questions on council, mayor, public services, voting.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Which group often votes on city ordinances, or local laws?
Who often leads a city government?
Which service is commonly planned by local government?
Which may be a local public safety service?
Who chooses many local elected officials?
choices: the United States president for every town

questions.question: What can a town meeting give residents a chance to do?
Which is most useful when asking a council for a crosswalk?
choices: describe where people cross and what makes it hard
show a drawing of a toy car only
write about a park in another state
ask the council to close every street

questions.question: How can local government pay for some public services?
choices: collect local taxes allowed by law

questions.question: Which project might a city parks department manage?
choices: fixing playground equipment on city land

questions.question: What does a local ordinance do?
choices: sets a rule for a community
sets a school lunch price in every state

questions.question: Why might a town test water from its public system?
choices: to set the time of a movie
to find which books should be sold
to check that drinking water is safe
to measure how loud the mayor speaks

questions.question: A streetlight is broken. Which is a sensible first step?
choices: report its location to the local public works office

questions.question: What is one reason local leaders ask residents for input?
choices: Residents can change federal laws on the spot.
Every resident will have the same idea.

questions.question: Which is a choice about a local budget?
choices: how much to spend on a city park repair
who serves on the U.S. Supreme Court

questions.question: What does it mean for a service to be public?
choices: A government makes it available for a community.
Only the mayor's family may use it.
It can only be used in a different town.
It must belong to one shop.

questions.question: Which source would confirm when a council meets?
choices: an old map with no dates
a bus timetable for another state

questions.question: Why might a city add curb ramps near crosswalks?
choices: to improve access for people using wheelchairs and others

questions.question: Which action is an example of civic participation by children?
choices: sharing an idea for a safer route to school

questions.question: Who might a community invite to explain how to stay safe during a fire?
choices: a coach from a different country
a member of the local fire department

questions.question: Two neighborhoods ask for a repaired sidewalk, but funds cover one this year. What information would help prioritize?
choices: who has the tallest tree nearby
which street name comes first in the alphabet
where the damage is worst and how many people rely on each route
